proposals.before: When the governor of Sichuan, Yusui, was impeached, Zailing was ordered to go and investigate.
proposals.after: When the Sichuan governor-general Yurui was impeached, Zailing was ordered to go and investigate.
proposals.reason: Chinese 裕瑞 is Yurui (not Yusui); 川督 denotes the Sichuan governor-general.

proposals.before: When the Sichuan governor Yusui was impeached, Zailing was ordered to go investigate.
proposals.after: When the Sichuan governor-general Yurui was impeached, Zailing was ordered to go investigate.
proposals.reason: Chinese 裕瑞 is Yurui; 川督 is governor-general rather than governor.

proposals.before: Zongshi Fukun, styled Zhenting, belonged to the Bordered Blue Banner and was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Limi, Yunsi.
proposals.after: Zongshi Fukun, styled Zhenting, belonged to the Bordered Blue Banner and was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Limi, Yunreng.
proposals.reason: Chinese 允礽 is Yunreng (Kangxi's heir), not Yunsi.

proposals.after: Zongshi Fukun, courtesy name Zhenting, was affiliated with the Bordered Blue Banner and was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Limi, Yunreng.

proposals.after: In the third year he was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall.
proposals.reason: 體仁閣 is Tiren Hall (Embodying Benevolence); Tirean is a misspelling.

proposals.before: He was ordered, together with Vice Minister Tong Hua, to proceed to Sichuan to investigate the impeachment of Governor Ding Baozhen and others; in their report they recommended that Baozhen be referred to the ministry for deliberation.
proposals.after: He was ordered, together with Vice Minister Tong Hua, to proceed to Sichuan to investigate the impeachment of Governor-General Ding Baozhen and others; in their report they recommended that Baozhen be referred to the ministry for deliberation.
proposals.reason: Chinese 總督 is governor-general, not governor.

proposals.before: He was transferred to be grand secretary of the Heir Apparent's household and through successive promotions reached the post of inner court academician.
proposals.after: He was transferred to be secretary (xima) of the Heir Apparent's household and through successive promotions reached the post of inner court academician.
proposals.reason: 洗馬 is xima, not grand secretary; the idiomatic rendering is nearer.

proposals.before: He was appointed governor-general of Rehe and again requested leave due to illness.
proposals.after: He was appointed lieutenant-general (dutong) of Rehe and again requested leave due to illness.
proposals.reason: 熱河都統 is a banner lieutenant-general / military governor post, not governor-general.

decisions.reason: s0043 reads 會川督裕瑞被劾: 裕瑞 is Yurui, not Yusui, and 川督 is the Sichuan governor-general. The prior idiomatic errs on both the name and the office; the proposed wording matches the Chinese.
The same Chinese 川督裕瑞 requires Yurui and governor-general in the literal field. Replacing Yusui and governor with those forms corrects real errors without changing the rest of the sentence.
s0092 names 理密親王允礽; 允礽 is Yunreng, not Yunsi. The prior idiomatic misreads the personal name; Yunreng restores the source.
Literal likewise must render 允礽 as Yunreng. The proposed replacement fixes only that naming error and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
s0033 has 體仁閣大學士; 體仁閣 is Tiren Hall. Tirean is a misspelling of that hall name, and Tiren matches the Chinese reading.
s0059 likewise reads 授體仁閣大學士. Correcting Tirean to Tiren restores the proper hall name without other change.
s0088 again has 體仁閣大學士. Tirean is erroneous; Tiren Hall is the accurate English for 體仁閣.
s0107 reads 十七年，授體仁閣大學士. The hall is Tiren, not Tirean; the proposed fix is complete and natural.
s0143 has 授體仁閣大學士 within the twenty-ninth-year appointments. Replacing Tirean with Tiren corrects the misspelling and preserves the rest of the sentence.
s0076 names 總督丁寶楨; 總督 is governor-general, not governor. The proposed idiomatic change fixes that office title and leaves the investigation report wording unchanged.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 查辦總督丁寶楨等被劾案

decisions.reason: s0038 reads 遷洗馬，累至內閣學士. 洗馬 is the xima (secretary of the Heir Apparent's household), not a grand secretary; the prior literal invents that rank, and the proposed wording matches the office and the idiomatic rendering.
s0124 has 出為熱河都統. 都統 is a banner lieutenant-general (dutong), not a governor-general (總督). The proposed office title matches the Chinese.

claimRetractions.reason: The English name Yusui was produced only by misreading 裕瑞 in s0043; the accepted repair restores Yurui, and no source-supported Yusui name remains.
The English name Yunsi was created only by misreading 允礽 in s0092; the accepted repair restores Yunreng, and no source-supported Yunsi name remains for this person.
